package.name: calib_bridge
package.description: Derives the D455 eye-on-base calibration from the already-trusted D405 eye-in-hand calibration (calib_eye_in_hand) instead of running easy_handeye2's own AX=XB solver on the D455: both cameras observe the same static tag at once, the D405 + live FK gives an independent fp3_link0-frame estimate of the tag, and inverting the D455's own simultaneous detection of that tag gives fp3_link0 -> D455 directly. Averages several such samples (take_sample/save_calibration services) and writes a standard easy_handeye2 .calib file.
